shortBio.en: Nine Inch Nails as industrial hub: one-person studio project scaled to touring band.
shortBio.zh: Nine Inch Nails 作为工业枢纽：一人棚内项目扩成巡演乐队。

whyHub.en: Person = project brand: Reznor writes/produces NIN; live lineup is expandable labor around the studio author.
whyHub.zh: 人物 = 项目品牌：Reznor 写作/制作 NIN；现场阵容是工作室作者周围的可扩展劳动力。

body.en:
Born 1965. Pretty Hate Machine (1989) and The Downward Spiral (1994) cite sequenced industrial rock, distorted vocals, and sample-heavy arrangement. NIN is legally/brand-wise Reznor’s vehicle; Atticus Ross later joins as co-writer/producer and film-score partner.

Hub: industrial rock’s mass US face is a solo authorship model wearing a band name.
body.zh:
1965 年生。Pretty Hate Machine（1989）与 The Downward Spiral（1994）引用音序工业摇滚、失真人声与采样密集编曲。NIN 在法律/品牌上是 Reznor 载具；后 Atticus Ross 成为合写/制作与电影配乐搭档。

枢纽：美国大众工业摇滚面孔是套着乐队名的独唱作者模型。

note.en: Founder and primary author; touring members rotate.
note.zh: 创始人与主作者；巡演成员轮换。
